wording.why: Sylas's Hijack itself deals no damage, but the stolen ultimate he casts usually does; players will argue both ways and the Rule doesn't say.
wording.suggestion: Add to the excludes: 'Sylas's Hijack (the stolen ultimate counts)'.

fun.why: Everyone has a few (Soraka, Tryndamere, Kindred, Shen), the set is big (33) and full of forgettable ones (Aatrox, Ryze, Taliyah, Yunara), so nobody lists it all.

champion:Soraka.why: Wish is the iconic pure-heal ult.

champion:Tryndamere.why: Undying Rage is the classic no-damage ult.

champion:Kindred.why: Lamb's Respite is a famous no-death zone.

champion:MasterYi.why: Highlander is a well-known pure buff.

champion:Shen.why: Stand United shield is well known.

champion:Taric.why: Cosmic Radiance invulnerability is well known.

champion:Bard.why: Tempered Fate stasis comes to mind quickly.

champion:Janna.why: Monsoon heal/knockback; many forget it does no damage.

champion:Karma.why: Mantra empowers her next spell; support players know it.

champion:Kalista.why: Fate's Call knocks up but deals no damage; ADC/support players know it, few think of it first.

champion:Lulu.why: Wild Growth is a well-known no-damage ult.

champion:Alistar.why: Unbreakable Will is known to tank players.

champion:DrMundo.why: Maximum Dosage heal is fairly obvious.

champion:Nidalee.why: Transform ults are an easy category once thought of.

champion:Sivir.why: On The Hunt team speed is moderately known.

champion:Mordekaiser.why: Players feel the Death Realm 'damages', so few name it.

champion:Vayne.why: Final Hour is a buff players rarely think of as an ult answer.

champion:Twitch.why: Spray and Pray is a buff; some will think it deals damage.

champion:Renata.why: Hostile Takeover berserk; some forget it.

champion:Heimerdinger.why: Upgrade!!! is easy to forget as a no-damage ult.

champion:Ryze.why: Realm Warp teleport rarely comes to mind.

champion:Aatrox.why: World Ender feels like a power spike, but it deals no damage.

champion:Camille.why: Players remember the arena, not that the R itself deals no damage.

champion:Rengar.why: 'Stealth ult' comes to mind for some.

gemCandidates.why: 'Oh of course!': World Ender is his biggest power spike, yet it only fears minions and grants speed and healing. About 0.06.
Fate's Call throws her Oathsworn and knocks enemies up but deals 0 damage. About 0.12, well outside the likeliest half now the Rule no longer names her.
Realm Warp is a famous play-maker that never touches an enemy; about 0.08.
